profile.headline: Software Engineer - Salesforce
profile.summary: A Certified Salesforce Platform Developer I and Administrator with experience in Designing, Administration, Configuration, Customization, Requirement analysis, Data Migration, and support of the salesforce platform. Proficient in Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning components, with a strong understanding of Salesforce best practices and limitations. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve the issues, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and deliver projects on time and within scope. Seeking new opportunities to further develop skills and contribute to the success of a dynamic organization.

positions.title: Salesforce Developer At Cognizant
positions.description:
- Work with key stakeholders to conduct planning sessions, construct user stories/ business requirements, developing flow diagrams, use cases etc.
- Document IT work instruction document for deployment and release management within Gilead.
- Design, configure & customize the Salesforce and come up with effective project execution techniques.
- Troubleshoot the issues and provide support/resolution to end users request via ServiceNow.
- Execute solution design activities such as data mapping, object modeling, page layout design and Rule logic definition in context of Salesforce application.
- Manage the data migration strategy into Salesforce from multiple sources. Data integration from external sources with Salesforce application.
- Monitor the analysis, design, implementation and execution of the test cases and test procedures for the functional, regression and system integration testing.
- Ongoing documentation throughout the development.
- Experience in designing of Visualforce pages, Apex classes, Lightning web component, Triggers, SOQL, SOSL, custom objects, custom labels, custom fields, Picklists, Page layouts, Lightning Record Page, Workflow Alerts & Actions, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Flows, Process builders, custom Tabs, custom reports, Record Types, Report folders, Custom Setting Record Types and Dashboards according to application requirements.
- Used LWC, Aura component, and Experience Cloud to build a client-facing single-page application.
- Good knowledge on sharing rules and user access privileges and Field Level Security.
- Proficient in working under Agile Development Environment.
- Leveraged Azure DevOps for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
- Knowledge in using source control Git & Copado. Used visual studio code & Eclipse IDE.
- Knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud and understanding of Salesforce data model/architecture to be able to assist in designing business applications.

positions.title: Salesforce Developer
positions.description:
- Worked on Salesforce organization and Visual studio code for development.
- Used LWC, Aura component, and Experience Cloud to build a client-facing single-page application.
- Leveraged SLDS and CSS with consistent styling for HTML elements.
- Utilized Apex Triggers for the business that meet best practices.
- Added declarative customization that is required to support the features in organization.
- Included the unique tools and capabilities of Sales app as a part of the organization implementation.
- Exposed Actionable reports and dashboards relating to the business in organization.
- Utilized Apex classes for testing the business logic in the backend.
- Utilized static resources in organization to upload images in cloud site.
- Managed version control using Git.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Applied technologies HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and MySQL for the development of a web application, which automated processes for employees to perform daily functions more efficiently and effortlessly.
• Create and execute MySQL SELECT, INSERT, and UPDATE queries to retrieve and manipulate data from database tables, sometimes using various types of joins to get data from multiple tables.
• Designed & developed single-page app Using HTML, CSS3, Twitter Bootstrap4.
• Debugging the issue, finding the root cause, resolving it timely manner.
• Creating design and test documentation, Unit, and integrated testing.
• Participated in the design review of the applications to come up with UI and provide the best possible recommendations for the applications from a UI standpoint.
• Worked on cross-browser compatibility and tested each and every web application on popular web • browsers such as Internet Explorer, Firefox, Safari, Chrome.
• Worked in an Agile environment, to ensure delivery of high-quality work with every two-week iteration.
